summary.en: Yoko Okino is starring in "The Stalker Who Laughted at the Darkness", a Tuesday Suspense Drama written by Nichiuri TV, and she invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to watch the shooting at the Beika Shrine. The cameraman, Morio Anzai, is murdered, and next to his body is a dying message spelling out the word "komainu", meaning stone lion. Location: Beika Shrine Time: 10:00-10:30 p.m Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Shingo Nachi, Taeko Mamegaki, and Yuji Shimazaki On the way back from the convenience store, Conan, Ran, and Yoko discover Anzai murdered at the shrine. Next to his body is a dying message, Komainu (Stone Lion), written with his own blood.
